title: Olink Target 48 Part 1/3: Incubation
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter all required protocol parameters in the provided fields above.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your custom labware files (JSON extensions) if needed.

steps.title: Upload Python protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload your protocol file (Python .py extension) to the Protocol tab of the Opentrons App.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the physical deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the Opentrons App; use calibration tips as described in the support articles.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the Run button in the Opentrons App to start the incubation protocol.
